briefdescription.para: Internal (runtime) form of a monomial ordering.

detaileddescription.para: Defines the encoded representation walked by the inner loop when two monomials are compared the operational counterpart to the declarative MonomialOrdering the user writes. The internal form is a list of mo_blocks; each block has a type (MO_LEX, MO_GREVLEX, MO_WEIGHTS, MO_REVLEX, MO_POSITION_UP/DOWN, ...), a variable count, and block-specific data. A comparison walks the block list and returns at the first block that breaks the tie. Encoded monomials are laid out so that the common case a leading degree or weight sum resolves after reading a single slot, and many orderings reduce to a memcmp on the packed bytes.

Translation from the declarative MonomialOrdering to this internal form happens once, at Monoid construction; the resulting MonomialOrder* is then frozen and reused on every inner-loop compare. Degrees and weights are 32-bit signed (deg_t); intermediate-degree overflows are caught by overflow.hpp.
